tools.name: find_sunny_destinations
tools.description: Ranked answer to "where is it sunny (and warm) in <month>?" — destinations sorted by that month's 0–100 Sunshine Score (long-term climate normals). tools.name: get_destination_climate
tools.description: Full climate card for one destination: 0–100 Sunshine Score, day/night °C, rainfall, midday UV index (WHO scale) and sea temperature for all 12 months, plus its best month on the Sunshine Score ("best time to visit" for sunshine), its sunniest month and hours of sunshine month by month, its Köppen-G

tools.name: compare_destinations
tools.description: Side-by-side sunshine/climate comparison of 2–5 destinations — overall or for one month ("Algarve or Crete in October?"). Returns each place's Sunshine Score, temperatures, rain, midday UV index and sea temperature, plus a one-line verdict of which is sunnier.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_destination_climate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Full climate card for one destination: 0–100 Sunshine Score, day/night °C, rainfall, midday UV index (WHO scale) and sea temperature for all 12 months, plus its sunniest month ("best time to visit" for sunshine), annual sunshine hours and peak midday UV. Accepts a city name ("Faro"), "city, country"" → after: "Full climate card for one destination: 0–100 Sunshine Score, day/night °C, rainfall, midday UV index (WHO scale) and sea temperature for all 12 months, plus its best month on the Sunshine Score ("best time to visit" for sunshine), its sunniest month and hours of sunshine month by month, its Köppen-G"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
